name: Bercial de Zapardiel (Spain)
description: Square crimson flag with a yellow diagonal band from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Bercial de Zapardiel (ears of wheat and a tower on red).
history: Municipal flag of Bercial de Zapardiel; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
